title: Prayer Time, Azan Alarm, Qibla
description:
As-salamu alaykum dear brothers and sisters! Muslimmer is a Muslim app with accurate Prayer times and Azan. With it, you can also read the Quran and use a Qibla direction compass! It's a must-have for all Islamic users in 2026. People of Islam who actively travel around the world want to always have a reliable Mecca finder at their disposal, get Athan or read daily Dua. Muslimmer will provide you with everything you might need to comply with the traditions of our religion. You'll never miss a single prayer with the help of our adhan.

Features

These are the features that Muslimmer contains: • Accurate schedule of prayer times based on your location or any manually selected location. • Azan time is a notification that calls you to prayer with different muezzin voices to choose from. • Qibla compass that shows you the direction to Kaaba, Masjid al-Haram and Mecca from any part of the world. • The full Holy Quran is available both as texts and audio recitations. • Tasbeeh counter for your Dhikr. • 99 names of Allah. • The Fortress of the Muslim is the book with dua. • A schedule of Muslim prayer times for a month (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha). • A map to help you to find halal restaurants and mosques (Masjids) nearby. • Hijri calendar with a list of holy dates such as Ramadan and Eid al-Adha.

Advantages

What makes the app stand out from others: • The most accurate prayer times with azan notifications. • The correct direction of the Qibla locator to the Kaaba location. • Al Qur'an with phonetics and translation. No matter which Surah or Juz you need, you'll be able to find it in a few clicks. • Audio recitations of Asma ul-Husna. • Hisn'ul Muslim is divided into categories, has a convenient search, and frequently used Dua can be added to favorites. • Complete Hijri calendar 2026 with holidays. • It is simple and user-friendly. You just install it on your gadget and you start using it immediately. • You can easily change the dhikr counter and compass themes or select Adhan voices.

What users might like

Users will love Muslimmer for the following reasons: • It is distributed free and entirely safe. Your privacy is our priority. • Design is sleek and its interface is intuitive. • Beautiful sound athan and Islamic tasbeeh counter. • It only takes you just one minute to figure out how the app functions. • It consumes a minimum of internet traffic and some of its functionality is available offline. Thanks to the app, you'll know what is most important in religion. If you've uttered the words of Shahadah not so long ago, the Muslimmer will help you to quickly familiarize yourself with religion. Hopefully, prayer time with azan alarm is useful to you! You should enjoy using Qibla finder and reading Al Quran!
